title: Reviewer Verdict
description: Structured verdict produced by the hardened-reviewer or reviewer-adversary subagent after inspecting a goal's manifest, diff, and spec.

reviewer_role.description: Whether this verdict was produced by the primary reviewer or the adversary second-pass.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was completed.

verdict.description: Overall verdict: clean (no concerns), concern (non-blocking issues found), blocking (halts the pipeline).

concerns.description: List of concerns found during review. Empty array when verdict is clean.

file.description: Relative path to the file containing the concern.

line.description: Line number of the concern (0 if file-level).

severity.description: blocking halts the pipeline; concern routes to auto-fix or escalation.

category.description: mechanical concerns may auto-fix; judgment and uncategorized concerns escalate.

checks_run.description: List of checks performed during this review pass.

name.description: Identifier for the check (e.g. scope_against_spec, secrets_scan).

outcome.description: Whether the check passed or failed.

evidence.description: Brief evidence or rationale for the outcome.
